# Code of conduct

This project is a friendly place to talk about chess and code. Everyone who
takes part, in issues, pull requests, discussions or anywhere else connected
to the project, is expected to help keep it that way.

## Expected behaviour

- Be respectful and patient, especially with people who are new.
- Give feedback on the work, not the person.
- Accept constructive criticism gracefully.
- Assume good intent, and ask before assuming otherwise.

## Unacceptable behaviour

- Harassment, insults or personal attacks.
- Discriminatory language or imagery of any kind.
- Publishing someone else's private information without permission.
- Sustained disruption of discussions.

## Enforcement

The maintainer may remove comments, commits or other contributions that break
this code, and may temporarily or permanently ban anyone who does so
repeatedly.

To report a problem, contact the maintainer privately through
[shabbirjamal.com](https://shabbirjamal.com). Reports are kept confidential.

This code is inspired by the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/).
